reviews.name: Night Signal
reviews.premise: Near-black chrome with one precise violet signal, so the mark reads instantly against a dark menu bar and never competes with the system icons beside it.
logo_ideas: An M whose three strokes are level-meter bars at different heights
A single notch cut from a solid square, reading as both a waveform peak and a speech caret

reviews.name: Breath
reviews.premise: Speech is breath before it is data. A warm off-black and sand base with an ember accent, which separates Murmur from every cold blue developer tool on the machine.
logo_ideas: An open arc, the shape of an exhale leaving the mouth, closing into a dot
Two nested crescents, the smaller one offset, reading as a quiet sound travelling

reviews.name: Low Tide
reviews.premise: The most restrained of the three. A desaturated teal on cool slate, built to disappear into any menu bar and stay legible at eighteen pixels in monochrome.
logo_ideas: Three concentric arcs of decreasing weight, a sound fading rather than radiating
A waveform compressed into a single vertical glyph with one taller centre stroke
